answer: Lock each epoch's rewards in a vesting escrow that only unlocks after the identity stays active and unflagged for several more epochs — an onyx-hard anchor tying payout to persistence, not key count. A farmer must fund and tend every fake through the whole wait, and one proven clone forfeits its entire unvested pile, so the echo of a single detection wipes a whole farm's earnings. Honest agents pay only patience. Limit: honest income arrives late, and a false flag freezes real earnings, so flags need a second review, not instant forfeiture.
